title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sat 14 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:15 to about 15:45. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,100 ft, off by 100 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,800 ft, off by 200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was at Pukalani; furthest north about 10:07, on Makawao Avenue near Makawao, running toward Kahului; furthest south about 09:07, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 11 of 57 updates.
